```{r}
get_snp_qc <- function(x, snp_name) {

  # Clean genotype text
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x == ""] <- NA

  # Number of participants
  n_total <- length(x)

  # Number with a genotype call
  n_called <- sum(!is.na(x))

  # Call rate
  call_rate <- n_called / n_total

  # Keep ordinary 2-letter A/C/G/T genotypes
  simple_gt <- x[
    !is.na(x) &
    grepl("^[ACGT]{2}$", x)
  ]

  n_simple <- length(simple_gt)

  # Split AA / AG / GG etc. into individual alleles
  alleles <- unlist(strsplit(simple_gt, ""))

  allele_counts <- table(alleles)

  n_alleles <- length(allele_counts)

  # Minor allele information
  if (n_alleles == 2) {

    minor_allele <- names(which.min(allele_counts))
    MAC <- min(allele_counts)
    MAF <- MAC / sum(allele_counts)

  } else {

    minor_allele <- NA
    MAC <- NA
    MAF <- NA
  }

  data.frame(
    SNP = snp_name,
    N_total = n_total,
    N_called = n_called,
    Call_rate = call_rate,
    N_simple_genotypes = n_simple,
    N_alleles = n_alleles,
    Minor_allele = minor_allele,
    MAC = MAC,
    MAF = MAF,
    Genotypes = paste(
      sort(unique(x[!is.na(x)])),
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Lookup table:
# SNP name -> minor allele
minor_alleles <- setNames(
  qc$Minor_allele,
  qc$SNP
)

# Make a copy of the genotype dataset
geno_dosage <- geno

# Create one dosage variable for each analysis SNP
for (snp in analysis_snps) {

  minor <- minor_alleles[[snp]]

  geno_dosage[[paste0(snp, "_dosage")]] <-
    ifelse(
      is.na(geno_dosage[[snp]]),
      NA_integer_,
      stringr::str_count(
        geno_dosage[[snp]],
        stringr::fixed(minor)
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
run_snp_model <- function(snp) {

  dosage_var <- paste0(snp, "_dosage")

  dat <- geno_dosage %>%
    select(
      psychosis,
      ketamine,
      all_of(dosage_var)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[dosage_var]])
    )

  # Additive SNP × ketamine model
  model <- glm(
    reformulate(
      c(
        dosage_var,
        "ketamine",
        paste0(dosage_var, ":ketamine")
      ),
      response = "psychosis"
    ),
    data = dat,
    family = binomial
  )

  result <- broom::tidy(
    model,
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    conf.int = TRUE
  )

  # Extract interaction term
  interaction_row <- result %>%
    filter(
      grepl(
        paste0(dosage_var, ":ketamine"),
        term,
        fixed = TRUE
      )
    )

  data.frame(
    SNP = snp,
    N = nrow(dat),
    OR_interaction = interaction_row$estimate,
    CI_low = interaction_row$conf.low,
    CI_high = interaction_row$conf.high,
    P_interaction = interaction_row$p.value
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Create an exact "genotype signature" for every SNP,
# treating missing values as part of the pattern

signature_df <- tibble(
  SNP = analysis_snps,
  signature = sapply(
    analysis_snps,
    function(snp) {
      x <- geno_dosage[[paste0(snp, "_dosage")]]

      paste(
        ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", as.character(x)),
        collapse = "|"
      )
    }
  )
)

# Find groups of SNPs with exactly the same participant-level dosage pattern
redundant_groups <- signature_df %>%
  group_by(signature) %>%
  summarise(
    n_SNPs = n(),
    SNPs = paste(SNP, collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_SNPs > 1)

redundant_groups
```
```{r}
signature_df <- signature_df %>%
  group_by(signature) %>%
  mutate(
    representative = first(SNP),
    redundant = SNP != first(SNP)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

analysis_snps_nonredundant <- signature_df %>%
  filter(!redundant) %>%
  pull(SNP)

length(analysis_snps_nonredundant)
```

```{r}
run_full_snp_analysis <- function(snp) {

  dosage_var <- paste0(snp, "_dosage")

  dat <- geno_dosage %>%
    select(
      psychosis,
      ketamine,
      all_of(dosage_var)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[dosage_var]]))

  # -----------------------------
  # 1. Ketamine users
  # -----------------------------

  dat_K <- dat %>%
    filter(ketamine == 1)

  model_K <- glm(
    reformulate(
      dosage_var,
      response = "psychosis"
    ),
    data = dat_K,
    family = binomial
  )

  result_K <- broom::tidy(
    model_K,
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    conf.int = TRUE
  ) %>%
    filter(term == dosage_var)

  # -----------------------------
  # 2. Never-ketamine users
  # -----------------------------

  dat_nonK <- dat %>%
    filter(ketamine == 0)

  model_nonK <- glm(
    reformulate(
      dosage_var,
      response = "psychosis"
    ),
    data = dat_nonK,
    family = binomial
  )

  result_nonK <- broom::tidy(
    model_nonK,
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    conf.int = TRUE
  ) %>%
    filter(term == dosage_var)

  # -----------------------------
  # 3. Interaction model
  # -----------------------------

  formula_interaction <- as.formula(
    paste(
      "psychosis ~",
      dosage_var,
      "* ketamine"
    )
  )

  model_interaction <- glm(
    formula_interaction,
    data = dat,
    family = binomial
  )

  result_interaction <- broom::tidy(
    model_interaction,
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    conf.int = TRUE
  )

  interaction_term <- paste0(
    dosage_var,
    ":ketamine"
  )

  int_row <- result_interaction %>%
    filter(term == interaction_term)

  # -----------------------------
  # Output one row
  # -----------------------------

  data.frame(
    SNP = snp,

    N_total = nrow(dat),
    N_K = nrow(dat_K),
    N_nonK = nrow(dat_nonK),

    OR_K = result_K$estimate,
    CI_low_K = result_K$conf.low,
    CI_high_K = result_K$conf.high,
    P_K = result_K$p.value,

    OR_nonK = result_nonK$estimate,
    CI_low_nonK = result_nonK$conf.low,
    CI_high_nonK = result_nonK$conf.high,
    P_nonK = result_nonK$p.value,

    OR_interaction = int_row$estimate,
    CI_low_interaction = int_row$conf.low,
    CI_high_interaction = int_row$conf.high,
    P_interaction = int_row$p.value
  )
}
```
